done_when: The commit hook refuses a commit inside a worker run that changes forge.toml unless the item's Done-when names forge.toml (settings fixes and release bumps keep working), saying plainly that settings change in their own fix; the worker brief says workers never edit forge.toml and should report a needed settings change in their last message instead; command tests cover a refused worker commit, an allowed settings fix, and a coordinator commit outside a worker run, for a new repo and one adopted on an earlier release
why: Workers sometimes edit forge.toml while building an unrelated task or fix (a client worker added a command to fast_test because a note mentioned it; earlier a worker moved the version pin), though forge.toml is the coordinator's to change, through a settings fix the owner asked for (reported by a client session, 2026-10-09)
